stem.en: Which of these is an investment for ABC Bakery?

text.en: Buying a second oven to bake more cakes in future
Paying this month's bill for electricity and gas
Paying the tax on this month's profit to the government
Buying flour and sugar for tomorrow morning's bread

explanation.en: An investment puts money into something in the hope that it brings income or profit in future. A second oven lets the bakery bake and sell more later. The other three are this month's expenses or tax.

hints.en: Which one will help the bakery earn more in the months ahead?
